description: USGS magnitude 2.5+ events of 30 days: mainshocks of magnitude 6+ and the smaller events within 100 km after them (aftershocks), with a check on the past whether they faded roughly as one over time (Omori's law, 1894). Radar earthquake headlines are matched to USGS events by the place named and marked aftershock / mainshock / independent. Describes what was recorded; not a forecast. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Fusakichi Omori (1868-1923).
name: get_omori
title: Omori sensor: is a 'new earthquake' in the news an aftershock of a recent large quake nearby
